## Overview

Khar'zul's blade is the greatsword that once belonged to the balor general **Khar'zul (The Flesh That Remembers)**, one of the Five Generals of the monster army. After his physical form was destroyed, his immortal essence was sealed within this very weapon — the only vessel in all of creation capable of containing him.

Over centuries, the blade has transformed. Steel gave way to living flesh. Veins spread beneath the metal. Muscles wrapped around the guard. A single enormous yellow demonic eye opened within the blade, forever watching the world around it. Now, none can tell where the demon ends and the sword begins. The blade *is* Khar'zul's body.

---

## Physical Description

- **Appearance**: A massive greatsword that appears partially organic. The metal of the blade has been overtaken by veins, muscles, and fleshy tendrils. Near the guard, a slit reveals a great yellow demonic eye that moves, watching its surroundings.
- **Weight**: Heavy, but responds differently to different hands — impossible for most to carry, but follows Balor as if drawn to him.
- **Aura**: The blade exudes an aura of ancient malice and power. Corruption visibly spreads from where the blade rests, and it pulses with a faint, rhythmic beat like a heartbeat.
- **Wrapping**: When traveling, Balor keeps the blade wrapped in layers of worn cloth so that only its steel edge remains visible to the outside world.

---

## History

### The Sealing

After the Last Alliance defeated Khar'zul's physical form, they discovered a terrible truth: his essence endured beyond death itself. No spell could erase it, no divine miracle could extinguish it, no prison created by mortal hands could contain it for long.

The greatest scholars and priests of the age searched desperately for a vessel capable of containing an essence that refused to perish. Every enchanted relic shattered beneath its corruption. Every magical prison eventually failed. Every divine seal proved temporary.

Only then did they realize the terrible truth: there already existed a vessel capable of containing Khar'zul — **his own sword**.

The blade had absorbed his blood, his victories, his hatred, and his corruption until it ceased to be merely a weapon. It had become an extension of his very existence. No other artifact in creation possessed a bond so profound with the balor, and no other object could survive the burden of containing him.

Through the greatest sealing ritual ever performed, they bound the immortal essence of the balor within the blade itself — not inside a gemstone, not within a magical prison, but inside the weapon that had served as his companion throughout countless wars. The greatest general of the Abyss became forever trapped within the very weapon he had once wielded.

### The Transformation

Centuries passed. The sword slowly began to change. Steel gave way to living flesh. Veins spread beneath the metal. Muscles wrapped themselves around the guard. Eventually, a single enormous eye opened within the blade, forever watching the world around it.

As years became centuries and centuries became legends, none could tell where the demon ended and the sword began. The sword had become his body.

### The Dissidents

Some who had stood upon that battlefield witnessed something they could not ignore. They had seen the impossible. The ritual had not *destroyed* Khar'zul — it had preserved him. To them, the prison was never a punishment, but a chrysalis. He was changing, evolving into something greater than any balor had ever been.

These dissidents disappeared into the shadows, carrying fragments of the sealing ritual, ancient records, forbidden knowledge, and relics recovered from the battlefield. Over centuries, they became known by another name: **The Crimson Covenant**.

---

The blade is in Balor's possession. It:
- Is **growing in power** alongside Balor, unlocking new abilities as he grows
- **Whispers constantly** to Balor, testing his will, offering power
- Requires the **Rite of Ash** to quiet when the whispers become unbearable
- Contains Khar'zul's **conscious essence** — the balor is aware, watching, waiting
- **Magnetizes toward Balor** — the blade seems to follow him, not the other way around

### The Eye

The eye within the blade is Khar'zul's connection to the outside world. It watches, learns, and influences. The blade seems to have a will of its own, and it has **chosen** Balor as its bearer. This choice is not fully understood — is Khar'zul biding his time, or is the imprisonment changing him in ways even he did not anticipate?

---

## The Whisperer

Khar'zul speaks to Balor through the blade. His voice is described as whispers carried on the wind, heard only in silence — while passing by Hrothgar's lodge or standing alone under the northern night sky. The words come in fragments:

> *"Vhar..." "Kha..." "Ashkar..." "Mortal..."*

The whispers:
- Grow stronger after battles
- Offer power in moments of weakness
- Test Balor's will and resolve
- Reveal fragments of knowledge about the Abyss, demons, and ancient wars
- Become unbearable if not quieted through the Rite of Ash

In the vision Balor saw when first touching the blade, the colossal balor figure spoke:

> *"At last... You do not wield me... You carry me."*


## Evolution (GM Reference)

The blade's power grows with Balor, unlocking new features at certain thresholds:

| Level | Stage | Features |
|-------|-------|----------|
| 1 | Awakening | +1 attack/damage, 2d8 slashing, sentience begins, faint whispers |
| 2 | Smoldering Heart | Becomes magical, +1d4 fire damage, advantage on Intimidation/Insight/Religion, Infernal Vitality (1d6+PB HP on kill, 1/short rest). Drawback: scent of blood intoxicates |
| 3 | Burning Will | Fire damage increases to 1d6, +2 Strength checks, Temp HP on fire damage |
| 4 | Flesh and Steel | Fire damage 1d8, advantage vs Charmed/Frightened, Hellbreaker (cone of infernal fire) |
| 5 | The Flesh That Remembers | **Avatar of the Living Prison** — Khar'zul takes complete control of Balor's body. Balor's consciousness is displaced, experiencing visions of Khar'zul's realm while the balor general uses his vessel freely. Physical manifestation: cloak of crimson flame, demonic transformation of Balor's features, blade fully integrates with Balor's arm. Enhanced melee (advantage on all attacks), empowered infernal abilities (Hellbreaker deals maximum damage, advantage on all saves, resistance to all damage), Khar'zul's whispers become commands that override Balor's will. Duration limited until Khar'zul's influence recedes or Balor's body can no longer sustain the possession. **First triggered involuntarily at Level 1 during the blackout.** Can Balor ever learn to trigger or resist this state? |

Drawbacks scale with power — whispers intensify, Khar'zul offers greater temptations requiring Wisdom saving throws to resist.

## Open Questions

1. ✅ **Why did the eye form?** — **Resolved.** Khar'zul's essence is evolving within the prison. The eye is his consciousness reaching outward — a symptom of the chrysalis transformation (see Secrets). The blade is no longer a prison; it is becoming Khar'zul's new body.
2. ✅ **Where was the blade hidden?** — **Resolved.** Initially hidden in the **Whispering Glacier** in the Frostmaw and later moved to **Fanghold's Vault**. 🛠️ **TODO**: The full journey from the Skallfang Clan to the Covenant's possession and back to Hrothgar needs to be resolved after reviewing the timeline.
3. ✅ **Did the blade follow Balor?** — **Resolved.** Yes. From the moment Balor was born, the blade's eye turned toward him. Seraphina discovered that she could not leave the blade behind — it would follow the baby. This was the first sign that the blade had chosen its vessel.
4. ⏳ **What are the exact requirements for the Rite of Ash?** — Known as a prayer in Old Abyssal spoken over the blade while meditating. Full parameters (duration, cost, failure conditions) remain undefined for campaign flexibility.
